text.text_excerpt: For an exceptional and VIP experience, come have a drink at the classy, upscale Arnaud's French 75. The bartenders and waiters are dressed to the nines and some will feel rather underdressed at the bar. Not to worry though, you'll receive impeccable service regardless of your attire (although I recommend business casual). We met up with Houston Yelpers Emmanuel and his lovely wife, Jay and had the BESTTT night there!!! One drink led to two and then...well we made some fun-tastic memories! We had to stand by the bar at the beginning of the night, but as the crowd trickled out, we were able to lounge on the comfy chairs in the corner the rest of the evening. We even managed to find our way ...

Arnaud's French 75 is great. In fact, it may be my new favorite fancy pants establishment. The atmosphere of this bar is fancy, inviting and reminds me of a different era. An era where fancy people dressed up, drank cocktails, and smoked the occasional cigar. Even though it is close to Bourbon Street, you feel a world away. The cocktails were excellent and bartender Chris Hannah was behind the bar. After reading all the reviews that mentioned him, I was a bit starstruck. Turns out he not only makes a great drink, but he is a nice, humble guy (more on that later). I picked a spot in the corner by the cigar case. As others have mentioned, this is the best spot in the bar. You can see the en...

I really, really love this bar and would say this is a must-visit, especially if you're a French 75 fan. We stopped in around 8:30pm on a weekday evening and seemed to have beat the rush of people -- when we left about an hour later, there were no free seats. It's a small bar just north of Bourbon Street (though the vibe could not be more different than on Bourbon), connected to Arnaud's restaurant. The interior of the bar is classy and beautifully decorated, and you feel like you've gone back in time when you walk in. We tried the namesake French 75, which was excellent.
